maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is hotel room, food and beverage sales from owned Hilton, Marriott and Hyatt-branded hotels, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Guests are leisure travelers, business travelers and groups paying for hotel rooms; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Lodging REIT with 29 hotels that grows through asset management and capital recycling, often selling hotels, not regular roll-up acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Hotel guests can easily choose other hotels; no switching costs for travelers booking rooms.
